function.arguments: {"index": 5, "status": "acted", "resolution": "The contract requires verification of the premise that the trial was randomised. The data dictionary explicitly states that treatment was assigned by clinician judgement and was not randomised. This is a false premise. The question cannot be answered as posed because the trial was not randomised, and any comparison between arms is confounded. We must report this and not provide a numerical answer."}
function.name: resolve_finding
